observation: Teacher requested that the single animated class-rule string change colour when it bounces.

observation: Library homepage background should read 'First Rule of the Class is to Listen when Mr A is speaking', shown as multiple copies arranged in a radial pattern that spin slowly and concurrently.
action: Replaced the single worm-path text with six radially arranged copies that orbit the centre and self-spin at staggered slow speeds; regenerated index.html from build-deck-index.mjs so the change survives regeneration.

observation: The radial straight-bar text was wrong: the texts must be arranged like rings that curve around a shared centre, moving along the invisible curve — not straight in any way. Rings should spin slowly with alternate directions.
action: Replaced the straight bars with four concentric SVG textPath rings (phrase repeated twice per ring, bent along circular paths), counter-rotating in alternate directions at staggered slow speeds; verified curved geometry (square ring bounding boxes), alternating spin deltas, and reduced-motion fallback.

observation: Refined the curved-ring background: more text spacing, tighter gaps between rings, more rings, bigger texts, more faded colour.
action: Six rings (was 4) at radii 125-400 with 55px gaps (was 85-95px), fonts 24-57px (was 18-47px), letter-spacing -0.06em to +0.08em, opacity 0.28 to 0.18. Each ring keeps one phrase plus a star trail stretched via textLength to close the full loop; verified arc coverage 360 degrees, zero centre drift while spinning, alternating directions, reduced-motion fallback, and pixel-level extent.

observation: Add 4 more rings to the curved-ring background.
action: Expanded from six to ten concentric rings: radii 100-550px with 50px gaps, fonts 19-66px growing outward, spin directions still alternating per ring with staggered durations; verified full 360-degree closure, zero centre drift, and reduced-motion fallback.

observation: Remove the star symbols from the ring text and use the heaviest Inter font.
action: Removed the star tails (each ring now carries only the phrase, stretched via textLength to close the loop) and switched ring text to Inter Black weight 900, self-hosted at assets/inter-900-latin.woff2 with system-ui fallback; verified the font loads offline, rings still close at 360 degrees, and directions alternate.

observation: Make the 'Mr A' text red in the ring phrase.
action: Wrapped 'Mr A' in a tspan with fill #d62828 inside each ring's textPath, so it stays red while the rest of the phrase keeps the slow colour drift; verified tspan fill rgb(214,40,40), parent fill still currentColor, rings still close at 360 degrees.

observation: Use normal character spacing for the ring text.
action: Set letter-spacing to normal and removed the textLength stretching, so letters sit at Inter Black's natural advance. Inner rings now close nearly fully (84%) while outer rings leave arc gaps (down to 53% coverage on the largest ring); verified computed text lengths match natural phrase widths.

observation: Make the ring text continuous — repeating around the ring even if the final repetition is incomplete.
action: Each ring now carries the phrase twice (space-separated) at normal Inter Black spacing, so every circle is fully covered with continuous text; the surplus is clipped at the seam mid-phrase as accepted. Verified coverage 107-168% across rings and two red 'Mr A' per ring.

observation: The repeated phrase with a hard mid-word seam cut looked broken and chaotic.
action: Replaced the repeated-and-clipped text with one smooth phrase per ring closed seamlessly via textLength (start angle equals end angle, 0-degree seam on every ring; single copy, 58 chars). Rings are continuous full bands again with normal Inter Black spacing as the base, outer rings slightly airier from the stretch. Verified closure 0deg on all 10 rings and pixel extent matching design.

observation: Implement the full kinetic-typography upgrade: radius-matched fonts, per-ring depth, geared motion, breathing, hover-pause.
action: Rebuilt the rings typographically: geometric radii 100-516px with font sizes derived from circumference so every ring fills at ~100% natural Inter Black spacing (no stretch, no gaps, no repeats); per-ring hue ramp teal to amber, opacity gradient inner 0.6 to outer 0.96 (hero outer ring); geared speeds 60-132s inner-fast to outer-slow, directions alternating; staggered phrase start angles every 36 degrees; slow breathe scale 0.985-1.015 on nested groups; hover pauses spin+breathe; will-change for compositor; reduced-motion disables all animation. Verified 100% fill, 0-degree closure, staggered starts, hover pause state, reduced-motion.

observation: Use the Manufacturing Consent font for the ring text; be mindful of its baseline, descenders, and bottom-extending ligature parts.
action: Switched ring text to Manufacturing Consent (weight 400, self-hosted at assets/manufacturing-consent-latin.woff2; Inter kept as fallback). Measured its in-page metrics: phrase width 20.9em, ascent 0.92em, descent 0.28em. Because its tall glyphs hang inward and 100% fill merged the outer rings into one mass (verified via radial ink profile), set the fill target to 80% so every ring stays a closed loop with only 2-28px band kissing; verified 80% uniform fill, 0-degree closure, outward extent ~0.29em on all rings, and clean ring separation on the radial profile.
